effects.effect: You use your immersion in the mystery of void magic to expand the reach of that magic better than other mages. The [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) of all your abilities that have the Magic, [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged), and Void keywords increases by 2 squares.
